# Chess Puzzles to PGN

Curated by Skill Harbor — digitizes chess tactics collections: it takes puzzle PDFs, puzzle screenshots, or manual puzzle entry and converts them into validated PGN files ready for Lichess study import. The workflow is strict about correctness — a fixed 10-stage pipeline (setup, puzzle extraction, PGN generation, validation, file naming, metadata verification, quality check, Lichess import validation, documentation, completion), an immutable file structure so nothing gets lost, and explicit rules that ban placeholder moves and truncated games: every puzzle must carry a real solution, proper headers, and the move sequence. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @dash1971. Honest caveats: accuracy depends on the source scans — verify a sample of solutions against your own analysis before bulk-importing to Lichess; it converts puzzle content, it doesn't find new tactics for you; a chess player yourself is the best quality control this pipeline has. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
